name: Young coconut
summary: A drinking coconut, cut open on the water. The provincial tourism portal serves it on the firefly boat with fruit. The 25 November 2024 candy article says a glass of fresh coconut water in the garden. A price is check on arrival.
origin: The boat and the orchards. Ben Tre’s crop is the coconut. This is the drink, not the candy.
howToEat: Cut open, with a straw, on the boat or in a yard. The firefly boat pairs it with fruit.
A stall price was not printed. The price is check on arrival.
where: The town boats and the orchards.
seoTitle: Young coconut in Ben Tre — cut open on the boat
seoDescription: Dừa tươi is a drinking coconut on the firefly boat or in the garden. A stall price is check on arrival.
